dcterms:description: A corpus containing recorded spoken data from Finnish traditional dialects, collected from more than 100 interviewees, totaling roughly one million lemmas. The data includes narratives from uneducated rural residents whose speech has not been affected by the standard language, and is grammatically annotated with information on speakers' age, gender, dialect, and grammatical information on each word.
dcterms:title: The Finnish Dialect Syntax Archive
